description: Know-your-business check in one call: finds the company in official registers (FR, SE, NO, FI, CZ, EE) or GLEIF, reads its LEI record and group parent, checks its EU VAT number in VIES (given, or worked out from the register ID) and screens the company and its parent against the OFAC, EU, UN and UK sanctions lists. Returns pass or review with plain flags and every source. Use when you onboard an EU customer, supplier or counterparty. Example: q=Spotify. Price $0.02/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

country.description: Only these countries for the register search: ISO codes or names, comma-separated

lei.description: LEI (20 characters) instead of a name

q.description: Company name (give q, vat or lei)

vat.description: EU VAT number with its country prefix; VIES gives the name where the member state shares it

name: pack_kyb_eu
title: KYB check, EU company verification
